scenes.headline: How a database lives on S3 and feels local
scenes.sub: A log in front, whole shards behind
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Tiller! This is how a write can be fast while the data lives on object storage.

scenes.text: Acknowledge a write from a small log in three zones. Later, fold the log into whole shards and upload those, so S3 never sits on the write path.
scenes.mark: S3 never sits on the write path
scenes.say: Acknowledge each write from a small log in three zones. Later, fold the log into whole shards and upload them. S3 is never on the write path.

steps.say: A commit writes its dirty pages to a log held in three availability zones.
As soon as a majority has it, the commit is acknowledged. No request has gone to S3.
In the background, the dirty pages are folded into whole shards, and each shard is uploaded as one object.

left.title: Only the changed pages
items: Old pages vanish from the image
Recovery loses data in 104 of 300 trials
left.say: If a fold writes only the changed pages, the image is missing the older ones. In the toy, that gave wrong data in a third of the crash trials.

right.title: The whole shard
right.say: If a fold always writes the whole shard, 256 KiB, every image is complete, and recovery matched the oracle every time.

scenes.title: Requests for the same commits
scenes.say: Requests scale with dirty shards per window, not with commits. Six thousand commits cost six thousand puts written straight, and one hundred eighty-eight with a sixty second fold.

scenes.label: wake from S3, 47 MiB, p50
scenes.note: about 5 ms when the data is on SSD
scenes.say: The price is the cold wake. Rivet reports six hundred eighty-nine milliseconds to wake from S3 and answer a first query on forty-seven mebibytes.

scenes.text: The speed comes from the log. The cheap storage comes from folding whole shards. Neither is visible in the open code yet.
scenes.say: The speed comes from the log, and the cheap storage from folding whole shards. The three zone log is not in the open code yet.

recap: Ack from a three zone log.
scenes.say: Ack from the log, fold whole shards into S3, and read them back on a cold wake.
